control_outage.outage_observation: first failed health check through confirmed restored readiness

client_cancellation_scope: No client cancellation was injected in these two campaigns; the gateway may request internal cleanup.
scope: Live same-host model/node and coordinator recovery. The outage is measured from the first failed health check through confirmed restored readiness. The separate 12000ms bound limits receipt observation, not total shutdown/startup. No independent coordinator, HA or public economic claim.
